name: Complaint
definition: A complaint that references a device unit.

name: Device
definition: A generic label that the source systems use for different things.

name: Device Model
definition: The design version of a device, identified by a model code.

name: Device Unit
definition: A physical device with a serial number.

name: Dose Event
definition: An administration of a drug dose captured on the case report form.

name: Kit
definition: A drug package shipped to a site, carrying a randomisation number.

name: Randomisation Number
definition: A number that assigns a kit to a treatment arm without revealing the arm.

name: Site
definition: A location that takes part in a study and receives shipments.

name: Study
definition: A clinical investigation identified by a unique study code.

name: Subject
definition: A participant enrolled in a study, identified by a subject code.

name: Visit
definition: A planned or actual meeting between a subject and a site during a study.
